description: This file is part of a formatting library for C++, providing formatters for standard library types such as filesystem paths, bitsets, optional, variant, error codes, type info, exceptions, and more. It includes external headers, defines formatter specializations, and manages conditional compilation based on C++ standard features.

classes.name: formatter<std::filesystem::path, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::filesystem::path with custom formatting options.

classes.name: formatter<std::bitset<N>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::bitset with padding and display options.

classes.name: formatter<std::optional<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::optional, displaying 'none' or the contained value.

classes.name: formatter<std::expected<T, E>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::expected, displaying expected or unexpected states.

classes.name: formatter<std::source_location>
classes.description: Formatter for std::source_location, outputs file, line, column, and function.

classes.name: formatter<std::variant<...>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::variant, outputs contained value or valueless state.

classes.name: formatter<std::error_code>
classes.description: Formatter for std::error_code, outputs category name and value.

classes.name: formatter<std::type_info, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::type_info, outputs demangled type name.

classes.name: formatter<std::exception, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::exception, outputs exception message and optionally type name.

classes.name: formatter<std::atomic<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::atomic, outputs the loaded value.

classes.name: formatter<std::atomic_flag, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::atomic_flag, outputs test() result.

classes.name: formatter<std::complex<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::complex, outputs complex number in parentheses.

classes.name: formatter<std::reference_wrapper<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::reference_wrapper, formats the referenced object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses format specifications from the format string.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the respective standard library type into the output context.
